description: Independently evaluates the DONE proof of a task or of a final run. It reuses the existing gate vocabulary rather than minting a second one: GATE_DECISIONS / GATE_REASON_CODES in src/lib/gate-decision.mjs stay the single source of truth, and this Agent produces an assessment that feeds gate derivation instead of deciding a merge.

implementedBy.note: Existing decision vocabulary and derivation; the Agent feeds it, it does not replace it.
Existing aggregation of reviewer results into one report.
